Dear Sir/Madam,
We wish to inform you that Mr. Neeraj Munjal was appointed as a Member of the Audit Committee of the Company with effect from August 04, 2025. Due to an inadvertent clerical oversight, this appointment was not reflected in the Integrated Corporate Governance Report filed for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.
We confirm that the composition of the Audit Committee has at all times been in compliance with the applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and the omission was purely unintentional. We regret the oversight and assure you that necessary care will be taken to avoid recurrence of such instances.
We request you to kindly take the above information on record.
